items.quote: Direct reports said that Torko Thalira championed accountability arrangements for public funds and it became a model adopted by other agencies.
Peers observed that Torko Thalira set the direction for the scenario planning exercise on future workforce needs across the public service.
Peers observed that Torko took ownership of the crisis response to a major system outage and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Torko Thalira was recognised sector-wide for her leadership of the settlement of a long-running contract dispute.
Peers observed that Torko Thalira contributed effectively to root cause analysis of recurring service failures.
Peers observed that Torko Thalira contributed effectively to presentations to senior management.
Torko managed prototyping novel ideas for frontline staff for her unit.
Several respondents noted that Torko took ownership of work with three sister agencies on a shared problem and steered it to completion.
Several respondents noted that Torko set the direction for analytics to guide resource allocation across the public service.
